Mailto link is preserved with mailto: scheme

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"mailto:user@example.com\">Email us</a>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
